title: The Spaces Within the Space That Bounce

features.name: nested echo
features.desc-on-touch: A space inside a space inside a space. When you call, your voice returns from a smaller depth each time, never escaping.

features.name: bounce-cavity
features.desc-on-touch: Light enters but must follow infinite reflections to leave. Time compresses here. A sound takes years to escape.

features.name: recursion-fence
features.desc-on-touch: A fence line of identical glyphs, repeating so densely they become one texture, then fractal, then a wall of nothing.

features.name: fear-loop
features.desc-on-touch: It bounces against the walls of itself: fear of the space, fear of being afraid, fear of stopping fearing. Infinite recursion.

inscription: inside the cavity, space learns to fold back on itself; fear discovers it can echo infinitely within bounded walls
